title: Hover inspect card is never clamped to the viewport — clipped off-window/under the tray for nodes near the right or bottom screen edge
detail: Fixed 232x52 card placed at anchor+(0.7s,0.5s) with no viewport or tray-band clamp. A node near the right/bottom edge (world 40x30 tiles camera-fit into 1280x720) renders the card partially off-window or under the hardware tray — traceability numbers unreadable.
recommended_fix: Clamp like popover_rect: flip left when x+232 exceeds v.win_w, clamp y into the viewport and above TRAY_CLEAR so edge nodes' numbers stay visible.

title: Hover card draws over the demolish popover's button while the cursor is within snap radius of the selected node
evidence:
app/main.odin:350 draws the popover first, then app/main.odin:387 `draw_hud(&app)` draws the card last:
			rnd.draw_demolish_popover(&app.view, &app.state.topology, &app.cat, app.sel_node, app.sel_pipe)
...		draw_hud(&app)
The hover block inside draw_hud has no selected-node guard:
	if (app.mode == .Run || app.mode == .Paused) && app.placing < 0 && !app.drag.active {
Geometry: card covers anchor.x+16..+248, anchor.y+12..+64; button (popover.odin:59-61, pop={anchor.x+18, anchor.y-20, 210, 92}) occupies anchor.x+28..+218, anchor.y+36..+62 — fully inside the card rect.
detail: With a junction selected (popover up), hovering within the 36px snap radius paints the near-opaque (alpha 240) card directly over the demolish button until the cursor leaves the radius.
recommended_fix: Skip the hover card while app.sel_node >= 0 (or draw it before the popover pass) so the two entity-anchored affordances never occlude each other.
